name: Evp
overview: The topic of Evp, as reflected in Scripture, contrasts the dangers of occult practices with the clear revelation and salvation offered through Jesus Christ. Deuteronomy 18:10 warns against engaging in divination and witchcraft, highlighting God's prohibition of such practices. In contrast, the New Testament emphasizes God's love and the gift of eternal life through faith in His Son, Jesus Christ (John 3:16; Romans 6:23). The revelation given to John (Revelation 1:1) underscores the divine authority and prophetic nature of Christ's message, while Matthew 5:2 shows Jesus teaching His followers, affirming the importance of His words over occult or deceptive teachings.
